name: @olai/tests
//scripts: Bun hosts the runner. Bun executes `.ts` natively, so there is no tsx, no ts-node and no build step between a step definition and the browser driving it — the `.bin/cucumber-js` shebang says node, and `bun run` executes it with bun anyway (verified in a dev shell with node removed from PATH entirely). That is why the dev shell needs no node: if this ever regresses, the symptom is a `node: command not found` from `bun run test`, and the fix is `bun ./node_modules/@cucumber/cucumber/bin/cucumber.js`, not adding node.
//devDependencies: playwright is pinned to 1.61.1 — the version of `pkgs.playwright-driver` in the pinned nixpkgs. The npm package ships only the driver's JS; the browsers come from the Nix store via PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH, and the driver refuses a browser build it was not compiled against. A minor-version drift here (kolu's 1.59.0, say) does not fail at install time — it fails at `chromium.launch()` with "Executable doesn't exist", pointing at a path inside the store that is real but wrong. Bump this only together with the nixpkgs pin, never on its own.
